profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Raytheon Technologies
profile.summary: Software Engineering professional skilled in real-time embedded software development for missiles and drones. Experience in Modeling & Simulation and adept at software architecture design. A natural leader and collaborator driven to develop quality products.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Active secret security clearance

Wrote real-time embedded flight software for missile and drone components including navigation, mission, and signal processing controllers

Led architecture design and implementation of embedded internal memory transfer system (DMA), built-in self-test system (BIST), and messaging capabilities
--Delivered architectural and functionality reviews to key stakeholders

Led large software team as Scrum Master

Developed Raytheon’s core common embedded and simulation framework
--Skilled at designing for reusability and extensibility 
--Taught classes on embedded framework
--Developed virtual test environment for downstream programs to use in software verification
--Implemented pipelines and test frameworks to protect software integrity
--Proved out static & dynamic analysis workflow & pipelines 
--Led a team of engineers in systematically removing weaknesses from Raytheon common code. Some of the eliminated vulnerabilities had the potential to cause flight failures
--Identified & mitigated flaws in software design, memory usage, and bugs

Designed and integrated complex software for assessing the health of hardware components through providing stimuli to units and analyzing data returned

Proactively seeks challenging growth opportunities. Demonstrated eagerness to learn from other disciplines to improve holistically as an engineering
--Rapid learner, excelling in skills learned on the job

Supported critical in-field flight tests, overseeing performance of software components in flight

Excellent troubleshooting skills developed through integrating software and hardware

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Planned and implemented automated test cases and software utilities in C# using a Selenium-based framework in an Agile environment

Discovered many bugs & errors that had gone unnoticed by the rest of the team for months

positions.title: Linux Lab Assistant
positions.description:
Instructed and performed troubleshooting alongside students enrolled in Data Structures, Web Engineering, Object-oriented Programming and Procedural Programming and learning the Linux Operating System

Analyzed code quickly in order to find bugs and design flaws

positions.title: Teacher Assistant - Department of Computer Science
positions.description:
Entrusted to rely on programming knowledge in scoring tests and assignments

Instructed students one-on-one at project work nights

honors.title: Magna Cum Laude Graduate
honors.issuer: Issued by Brigham Young University-Idaho · Jul 2016
